Name: ADELAIDE RIVER
Description: The Town is located 110km south of Darwin.
HistoryDesc:
The Town takes its name from the adjacent Adelaide River, which was discovered by LR Fitzmaurice and C Keys of the HMS Beagle in 1839 and named in honour of Queen Adelaide, who was the Dowager Queen at the time.  The Adelaide River flows into Clarence Strait, named after her husband William IV, Duke of Clarence.

The QCE Hotel (Quiet, Comfort and Ease) was established by Edward Hopewell in the 1874 on the southern bank of the River adjacent to the crossing and the Overland Telegraph Line which had been established in 1872.  Following WWII, the War Cemetery, a hotel and other facilities were developed on the northern side of the crossing, the site of the Verburg farm during the 1920s.

On 11 January 1962, an area of 626.8 hectares was proclaimed as a town site and given the name of Adelaide River.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Ali Curung is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply. Ali Curung  is connected to the Tennant Creek electricity grid.

Ali Curung has a plentiful groundwater source but with marginal quality water. The water supply is, disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and monitored monthly for microbes. The water supply has an advanced water treatment plant which removes from drinking water identified naturally occurring minerals that exceed the recommended levels of the Australian Drinking Water Guidelines.
Ali Curung has a septic tank effluent pumping system for the transfer of effluent to sewer ponds from septic tanks on houses and buildings.
Warlpiri, Alyawarr, Kaytetye and Warumungu.

Ali Curung is located south east of Tennant Creek on the Warrabri Aboriginal Land Trust. Ali Curung is surrounded by Neutral Junction, Murray Downs and Singleton Pastoral Properties.

Name: ALICE SPRINGS
Description: The Town is located 1290km south of Darwin.
HistoryDesc:
It is understood the Alice Springs waterhole was discovered and named by Government Surveyor W.W. Mills in March 1871, when he explored the MacDonnell Ranges during the Overland Telegraph Line construction.

Mills named the pool after Mrs Alice Todd, wife of the Superintendent of Telegraphs, Sir Charles Todd, and the daughter of Mr E. Bell of Cambridge.

The waterhole became the site for the Alice Springs Telegraph Station.

Government Surveyor David Lindsay surveyed the township in 1888 and named it Stuart after John McDouall Stuart the first European to blaze the trail from SA across the centre of Australia to the north coast.

After the railway arrived in Stuart in 1929, the town grew and a new post office was opened in Railway Terrace in 1932.  The post office was still called Alice Springs and the town Stuart.  However, the following year (CG 50 of 31/08/1933), the town was gazetted as Alice Springs.

Projects.Title: THE PROGRAM WILL PROVIDE CAPPED GRANTS TO ELIGIBLE BUSINESSES TO CONTRIBUTE TO MANDATORY TRAINING, CERTIFICATION, AND ACCREDITATION OF GROUND HANDLING WORKERS ESSENTIAL FOR THE OPERATION OF AIRCRAFT.
Projects.Description: A SIGNIFICANT PORTION OF AVIATION GROUND HANDLING STAFF HAVE NOT WORKED SINCE MARCH 2020 AND DUE TO THIS LONG PERIOD OF NEGLIGIBLE FLYING ACTIVITY, THE GROUND HANDLING WORKFORCE ARE LIKELY TO REQUIRE RETRAINING AND REACCREDITATION TO ENSURE SAFETY STANDARDS ARE MAINTAINED FOR ALL FLIGHTS. THE GRANT CONTRIBUTION WILL SET A FLOOR TO ENSURE THAT THE SECTOR IS IN A POSITION TO RESPOND AS DOMESTIC FLYING ACTIVITY RECOVERS. IT IS ANTICIPATED THAT THE PROGRAM WILL COVER APPROXIMATELY 30% OF THE TRAINING REQUIREMENTS OF THE PRE-COVID WORKFORCE. TRAINING SUPPORT WOULD BE AVAILABLE FOR BOTH NEW AND EXISTING EMPLOYEES, AS REQUIRED TO SUPPORT AVIATION RECOVERY. THE CAPPED GRANTS WILL NOT COVER THE COMPLETE TRAINING REQUIREMENTS OF ALL EMPLOYEES.

Projects.Title: ENSURING PROVISION OF ESSENTIAL PRIMARY HEALTH CARE SERVICES
Projects.Description: THE COMMONWEALTH HEALTH WORKFORCE PROGRAM DELIVERS HEATH WORKFORCE OUTCOMES AND SUPPORT FOR RURAL OUTREACH HEALTH SERVICES. THE HEALTH WORKFORCE PROGRAM IS DELIVERED UNDER THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND AGED CARE&RSQUO;S OUTCOME 1.4 &NDASH; HEALTH WORKFORCE. THIS OUTCOME IS INTENDED TO IMPROVE IMPROVE THE QUALITY, DISTRIBUTION AND PLANNING OF THE AUSTRALIAN HEALTH WORKFORCE TO BETTER MEET THE NEEDS OF THE COMMUNITY AND DELIVER A SUSTAINABLE, WELL DISTRIBUTED HEALTH WORKFORCE. IN THE 2022-23 BUDGET, THE AUSTRALIAN GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCED A LANDMARK LONG-TERM ENGAGEMENT WITH THE ROYAL FLYING DOCTOR SERVICE (RFDS OF AUSTRALIA). THIS ANNOUNCEMENT COMPRISES OF THIS &LSQUO;ENSURING PROVISION OF ESSENTIAL PRIMARY HEALTH CARE SERVICES IN RURAL AND REMOTE AUSTRALIA&RSQUO; PROGRAM, A 10-YEAR STRATEGIC AGREEMENT AND UP TO APPROXIMATELY $1 BILLION OVER A PERIOD OF UP TO TEN YEARS TO PROVIDE ESSENTIAL PRIMARY HEALTH CARE SERVICES AND AEROMEDICAL EVACUATIONS FOR RURAL AND REMOTE PATIENTS IN AREAS OF MARKET FAILURE OR BEYOND WHERE NORMAL MEDICAL INFRASTRUCTURE WOULD OTHERWISE PROVIDE SERVICES. THIS INCLUDES REFORM OF THE COMMONWEALTH&RSQUO;S PARTNERSHIP WITH THE RFDS OF AUSTRALIA TO INCLUDE COLLABORATIVE ANNUAL SERVICE PLANNING, AND INCREASED FLEXIBILITY AND RESPONSIVENESS IN FUNDING ALLOCATION AND SERVICE LEVELS TO ENSURE HEALTH SERVICES ARE DELIVERED TO THOSE COMMUNITIES MOST IN NEED, IN RURAL AND REMOTE AUSTRALIA.&NBSP;&NBSP;

TRAINING SUPPORT WOULD BE AVAILABLE FOR BOTH NEW AND EXISTING EMPLOYEES, AS REQUIRED TO SUPPORT AVIATION RECOVERY. THE CAPPED GRANTS WILL NOT COVER THE COMPLETE TRAINING REQUIREMENTS OF ALL EMPLOYEES.

Projects.Title: WORKING WITH INDIGENOUS LAND MANAGERS ACROSS THE DESERT TO REFINE AND CALIBRATE AN ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITION ASSESSMENT METHOD THAT INTEGRATES INDIGENOUS KNOWLEDGE AND REMOTE SENSING TECHNOLOGIES.
Projects.Description: THE IDA LED THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE RECENTLY ACCREDITED &LSQUO;DESERT HABITAT METHOD&RSQUO; (DHM V.1) (HTTPS://WWW.ACCOUNTINGFORNATURE.ORG/METHOD-CATALOGUE), THE FIRST ACCOUNTING FOR NATURE METHOD DEVELOPED BY AN INDIGENOUS ORGANISATION. THE DHM OUTLINES AN INNOVATIVE APPROACH FOR REPORTING ON THE CONDITION OF NATIVE VEGETATION AS HABITAT FOR NATIVE ANIMALS, DRAWING DIRECTLY ON THE TRADITIONAL KNOWLEDGE OF FIRST NATIONS PEOPLE COMBINED WITH INNOVATE USE OF REMOTE SENSING TECHNOLOGIES, FOR AN AREA THAT IS APPROXIMATELY 30% OF THE AUSTRALIAN LANDMASS. THIS PROJECT WILL ENSURE THAT THE DHM DEVELOPED IS FIT-FOR-PURPOSE FOR DELIVERY ON THE GROUND AND FOR INDIGENOUS ENGAGEMENT IN FUTURE BIODIVERSITY MARKETS BY: 1) FIELD CALIBRATING THE DHM &NDASH; ACROSS 4 PILOT SITES WORK WITH INDIGENOUS LAND MANAGEMENT GROUPS TO FINALISE A SET OF TRADITIONAL OWNER ENDORSED FIRE METRICS, DETERMINE REGIONALLY RELEVANT CONDITION TARGETS, AND VERIFY THAT THE ADDITIONAL INPUT DATASETS REQUIRED BY THE DHM ARE ACCURATE FOR THE 4 SITES SO THAT THE SITES ARE &LSQUO;PROJECT REGISTRATION READY&RSQUO; (I.E. VEGETATION & WEED MAPPING VERIFIED/COMPLETED, PHOTO-SITES ESTABLISHED AS PER DHM) 2) INCREASING CAPACITY AND KNOWLEDGE - DEVELOPING AND DISSEMINATING COMMUNICATION PRODUCTS AND THE HOSTING OF TWO REGIONAL WORKSHOPS (FOCUS IS BOTH ON-GROUND INDIGENOUS GROUPS AND STAFF, PLUS OTHER SUPPORT AGENCIES (E.G. NRM BODY STAFF, ECOLOGIST)).&NBSP; 3) UPDATING APPROACH - REVIEWING AND COMMUNICATING THE RESULTS OF TRIALS AND ADAPT THE DHM (FOR ACCOUNTING FOR NATURE, NATURE REPAIR MARKET, OR EQUIVALENT SCHEME) AS REQUIRED BASED ON RESULTS AND FEEDBACK FROM TRADITIONAL OWNERS AND LAND MANAGERS.

Projects.Title: PACIFICAUS SPORTS GRANTS SUPPORT PARTNERSHIPS IN RUGBY UNION, RUGBY LEAGUE, SOCCER, NETBALL, CRICKET, AFL AND PREPARATIONS FOR THE 2024 PARIS OLYMPICS AND PARALYMPICS, PRIMARILY IN FIJI, NAURU, PAPUA NEW GUINEA, SAMOA, SOLOMON ISLANDS, TONGA AND VANUATU.
Projects.Description: PACIFICAUS SPORTS&RSQUO; PURPOSE IS TO STRENGTHEN PEOPLE-TO-PEOPLE LINKS BETWEEN AUSTRALIA AND THE PACIFIC THROUGH SPORT TO ENHANCE AUSTRALIA&RSQUO;S RELATIONSHIPS AND STANDING IN THE PACIFIC. PACIFICAUS SPORTS DOES THIS BY FOSTERING ELITE SPORT PATHWAYS AND LINKAGES THAT FACILITATE REGULAR COMPETITION AND ENGAGEMENT BETWEEN AUSTRALIA AND PACIFIC TEAMS, ATHLETES AND OTHER SPORT STAKEHOLDERS. THE OBJECTIVES OF PACIFICAUS SPORTS PARTNERSHIP GRANTS ARE: (1) DEVELOPING PATHWAYS FOR PACIFIC TEAMS AND ATHLETES TO PLAY IN HIGH LEVEL AUSTRALIAN SPORTS COMPETITIONS: (2) SUPPORTING AUSTRALIAN SPORTS CODES TO INCREASE THEIR PRESENCE AND PARTICIPATION IN THE PACIFIC; AND (3) DEVELOPING PATHWAYS FOR EMERGING ATHLETES FROM THE REGION TO BENEFIT FROM HIGH PERFORMANCE COACHING, TRAINING, AND COMPETITION. THIS GRANT WILL ENABLE NETBALL AUSTRALIA TO CONTRIBUTE TO THESE OBJECTIVES USING NETBALL THROUGH ACTIVITIES INCLUDING SUPPORT FOR PACIFIC TEAMS AND PLAYERS TO COMPETE AND TRAIN IN AUSTRALIA, SUPPORT FOR AUSTRALIAN NETBALL CLUBS TO ENGAGE WITH THE PACIFIC, AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF HIGH PERFORMANCE WORKSHOPS AND COACHING DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS.

Projects.Title: MYRIGHTS AWARENESS REMOTE DISABILITY CAMPAIGN
Projects.Description: MCRIED LIVING PTY LIMITED WILL DELIVER THE &LSQUO;MYRIGHTS AWARENESS REMOTE DISABILITY CAMPAIGN&RSQUO; PROJECT AS THE LEAD ORGANISATION. THE PROJECT WILL FOCUS ON THE PRIORITY COHORTS OF ABORIGINAL AND TORRES STRAIT ISLANDERS LIVING IN RURAL AND REMOTE LOCATIONS. THE ACTIVITIES WILL BE DELIVERED IN THE REMOTE COMMUNITY OF UTOPIA, NORTHERN TERRITORY, WITH THE CREATION OF AN ONLINE PLATFORM THAT WILL PROVIDE ONGOING ACCESS TO EDUCATIONAL RESOURCES AND SUPPORT. THE PLATFORM TO BE ADAPTABLE ACROSS OTHER REMOTE COMMUNITIES IN THE FUTURE, BENEFITING BOTH PARTICIPANTS AND LOCAL SERVICE PROVIDERS. &NBSP; MCRIED LIVING PTY LIMITED WILL ACTIVELY INVOLVE PEOPLE WITH DISABILITY IN ALL ASPECTS OF THE PROJECT AND WILL DELIVER THE PROJECT TO ENHANCE THE UNDERSTANDING NDIS PARTICIPANTS IN UTOPIA, NORTHERN TERRITORY HAVE OF THEIR RIGHTS. THE PROJECT WILL DEVELOP CULTURALLY TAILORED, MULTILINGUAL EDUCATIONAL MATERIALS AND DELIVERING INTERACTIVE WORKSHOPS THAT ARE CO-DESIGNED AND FACILITATED BY LOCAL CULTURAL MENTORS, INCLUDING INDIVIDUALS WITH DISABILITY.&NBSP;

AliasNameDescription: The community Alice Springs is not known to have any other aliases.
HistoryDescription:
It is understood the Alice Springs waterhole was discovered and named by Government Surveyor W.W. Mills in March 1871, when he explored the MacDonnell Ranges during the Overland Telegraph Line construction.

Mills named the pool after Mrs Alice Todd, wife of the Superintendent of Telegraphs, Sir Charles Todd, and the daughter of Mr E. Bell of Cambridge.

The waterhole became the site for the Alice Springs Telegraph Station.

Government Surveyor David Lindsay surveyed the township in 1888 and named it Stuart after John McDouall Stuart the first European to blaze the trail from SA across the centre of Australia to the north coast.

After the railway arrived in Stuart in 1929, the town grew and a new post office was opened in Railway Terrace in 1932.  The post office was still called Alice Springs and the town Stuart.  However, the following year (CG 50 of 31/08/1933), the town was gazetted as Alice Springs.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Alpurrurulam is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply.
Alpurrurulam  has a limited groundwater source with marginal quality water. The water supply is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and monitored monthly for microbes.
Alpurrurulam has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Alyawarr
Barkly Regional Council
Barkly
Alpurrurulam is a Community Living Area south east of Tennant Creek within the Lake Nash Pastoral Property just west of the Queensland border.

Name: ALYANGULA
Description: On northwest corner of Groote Eylandt. Groote Eylandt is around 650 km east of Darwin and 50 km off the Arnhem Land coast in Australia's Gulf of Carpentaria. It is Australia's third largest island. The island is approximately 60 km north south and 40 km east west. It contains a number of rivers and streams which may make travel throughout the island difficult. On the island there is an 18km bitumen road from Alyangula to Angurugu (takes 20 minutes). Most other roads are dirt so a 4-wheel drive is essential.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Amoonguna is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply. Amoonguna is connected to the Alice Springs electricity grid.
Amoonguna has a plentiful groundwater source with good quality water, which is chlorinated and monitored monthly for microbes.
Amoonguna has a septic tank effluent pumping system for the transfer of effluent to sewer ponds from septic tanks on houses and buildings.
Eastern Arrente
MacDonnell Regional Council
Namatjira
Amoonguna is located on the Amoonguna Aboriginal Land Trust just to the south east of Alice Springs.

LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Unemployment rate (%) at the time of the Census. This is the number of unemployed persons expressed as a percentage of the total labour force. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Labour force participation
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Labour force participation rate (%) at the time of the Census. This is the number of unemployed persons expressed as a percentage of the total labour force. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Employment to population
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Employment to population rate (%) at the time of the Census. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of core activity need for assistance
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Number of people with a profound or severe core activity limitation. People with a profound or severe core activity limitation are those needing assistance in their day to day lives.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Ampilatwatja is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply. Ampilatwatja is connected to the Arlparra electricity grid.

Ampilatwatja has marginal quality water due to poor aesthetic characteristics, including elevated levels of hardness, and high levels of total dissolved solids affecting colour and taste. Capacity of the groundwater supply is adequate.
Houses and buildings at Ampilatwatja are fitted with private septic systems.
Alyawarr
Barkly Regional Council
Barkly
Ampilatwatja is located north east of Alice Springs on the Aherrenge Aboriginal Land Trust. The community is surrounded by the pastoral properties of Ammaroo, Derry Downs and Elkedra.

Name: ANGURUGU
Description:
The community is situated on the banks of the Angurugu River, half way down the western coast of Groote Eylandt. Groote Eylandt is around 650 km east of Darwin and 50 km off the Arnhem Land coast in the Gulf of Carpentaria.

Apart from the weekly freight barge service, the communities of Groote Eylandt are accessed primarily by air.  Groote Eylandt airport, located 1 km from Angurugu, is the main air access point for the island.  Owned and maintained by Gemco, the airstrip is sealed and there are flights to and from Nhulunbuy/Darwin most days.  Travel time to Nhulunbuy: 30-50 minutes, to Darwin: 1.5-2 hours.  Whilst an 18 km all weather, sealed road links Angurugu to Alyangula most other roads on the island are dirt so a 4-wheel drive is essential.  Given the number of rivers and streams, travel throughout the island during the wet season can be difficult.

Angurugu has a fully reticulated sewerage system.

Arnhem

Name: AREYONGA
Description:
The community is located 240 km west from Alice Springs by road in a rocky valley of the James Range. It takes 2.5 hours to drive there.  By road, it takes 5 minutes to drive to the closest airstrip in the community then 40 minutes to fly to Alice Springs.

The access road to the community consists of 130 kms of sealed road from Alice Springs to Ntaria, then 90 kms of dirt road. From the turn off to Utju there is a further 20kms of gravel-sheeted road. The road is often quite rough with corrugations and sand and "bulldust" patches are not uncommon. A few creek crossings make the road impassable in fairly extreme wet conditions. Caution required at 'Devils Elbow' at approach to creek crossing accessing community entry point.

Services.Comments: The access road consists of sealed road from Alice Springs to Gosses Bluff Juction (185 km), then dirt road to Areyonga (55 km). The dirt part of the road is often quite rough with corrugations. A few creek crossings make the road impassable in fairly extreme wet conditions. Caution required at 'Devils Elbow' at approach to creek crossing accessing community entry point. It takes about 2.5 hours to drive there.

Areyonga has a limited groundwater source with adequate quality water, which is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and monitored monthly for microbes.
Areyonga has a fully reticulated sewerage system.

Areyonga is located west of Alice Springs within the crevice of the surrounding hills on the Haasts Bluff Aboriginal Land Trust.

Name: ATITJERE
Description:
The community is located 215 km from Alice Springs by road and it takes 2.5 hours to drive.  It takes 10 minutes to drive to the closest airstrip in Atitjere and 30 minutes to fly to Alice Springs.

The Plenty Highway is sealed and in good condition for the first 150 km from the Stuart Highway, while the remaining 65 km to the Community is a gravel formation with sealed flood ways. The condition of this section of road is reasonable but requires constant maintenance.
The main access road from the Plenty Highway to the community (1.2 km) is a gravel road in good condition.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Barunga is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply. Barunga  is connected to the Katherine electricity grid.
Barunga has a surface water source which is filtered through a cartridge system and disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and ultraviolet, and monitored monthly for microbes.
Barunga has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Eastside Kriol
Roper Gulf Regional Council
Stuart
Barunga is located east of Katherine on the Beswick Aboriginal Land Trust.

Name: BATCHELOR
Description: The town is about 100 km south of Darwin and is the entry point for visitors to the stunning Litchfield National Park. A sealed road provides access to the town.
HistoryDesc:
Named after Egerton Lee Batchelor (1865-1911), politician, born 10 April 1865 in Adelaide. 

Batchelor was a central figure in the South Australian labour movement as early as his twenties and it is not surprising that he was one of the leading foundation members and a driving force in the formation of the United Labour Party in 1891. First elected to the SA House of Assembly in 1893 he served until his resignation in 1901 in order to enter Federal politics. He was immediately elected to the House of Representatives and served there until his death on 8 October 1911. From 1908 until his death he was Minister for External Affairs and 1911 he also took over responsibility for the Northern Territory. Such was his popularity that during his parliamentary career, both state and federal, he was never defeated in an election. He died while climbing Mount Donna Buang near Warburton, Victoria from a heart attack.

Projects.Title: REMOTE ABORIGINAL STUDENTSÂ€¿ HIGH SCHOOL RETENTION AND POST-SCHOOL PATHWAYS
Projects.Description: IMPROVING SECONDARY SCHOOL COMPLETION IS CRITICAL FOR REMOTE ABORIGINAL STUDENTS' PATHWAYS TO WORK AND FURTHER STUDY. WHILE STATISTICS SHOW SMALL IMPROVEMENTS IN REMOTE HIGH SCHOOL RETENTION, YEAR 12 COMPLETION DOES NOT GUARANTEE EMPLOYMENT OR ENTRY TO FURTHER OR HIGHER EDUCATION, AND IN REMOTE COMMUNITIES, WORKFORCE PARTICIPATION AND HIGHER EDUCATION ENGAGEMENT ARE EXTREMELY LOW. THIS PROJECT AIMS TO DETERMINE WHAT SCHOOLS CAN DO TO RETAIN STUDENTS TO SUPPORT TRANSITION TO WORK AND FURTHER STUDY. PROJECT OUTCOMES INCLUDE STRATEGIES TO IMPROVE LITERACY AND NUMERACY, WORK READINESS, CONFIDENCE AND TRANSITION TO LIFE BEYOND SCHOOL. THE RESEARCH WILL CONTRIBUTE TO SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC BENEFITS FOR REMOTE SCHOOLS, STUDENTS AND THEIR COMMUNITIES.

HistoryDescription:
Named after Egerton Lee Batchelor (1865-1911), politician, born 10 April 1865 in Adelaide. 

Batchelor was a central figure in the South Australian labour movement as early as his twenties and it is not surprising that he was one of the leading foundation members and a driving force in the formation of the United Labour Party in 1891. First elected to the SA House of Assembly in 1893 he served until his resignation in 1901 in order to enter Federal politics. He was immediately elected to the House of Representatives and served there until his death on 8 October 1911. From 1908 until his death he was Minister for External Affairs and 1911 he also took over responsibility for the Northern Territory. Such was his popularity that during his parliamentary career, both state and federal, he was never defeated in an election. He died while climbing Mount Donna Buang near Warburton, Victoria from a heart attack.

Name: BELYUEN
Description: The community is located on the eastern side of Cox Peninsula approximately 20 km south of Mandorah. It is 128 km by road from Darwin. Alternatively a ferry trip from Darwin to Mandorah takes approximately 14 minutes and leaves at regular times daily. There are no overnight ferry services between Mandorah and Darwin.
HistoryDesc:
The Aboriginal community of Belyuen was established as Delissaville and changed to Belyuen in 1975.  

Belyuen takes its name from a nearby waterhole known by that name.

HistoryDesc:
Hingston was requested by residents in this district to petition that the town be named Broad Town "after A. Broad Esq the pioneer squatter of McArthur River."
On McArthur River, Gulf of Carpentaria.

Projects.Description: THE OBJECTIVE OF THE GRANT IS TO INCREASE AND IMPROVE TELECOMMUNICATIONS RESILIENCE IN REGIONAL AND REMOTE COMMUNITIES AT RISK OF NATURAL DISASTERS, INCLUDING AREAS RECENTLY AFFECTED BY NATURAL DISASTERS SUCH AS BUSHFIRES AND FLOODS. THE INTENDED OUTCOME OF THE PROGRAM IS TO EXTEND THE OPERATION OF STAND SKY MUSTER PLUS COMMUNITY WI-FI SERVICES AVAILABLE IN EXISTING EVACUATION CENTRES AND EMERGENCY FACILITIES, AND EXPAND THE CURRENT SERVICE FOOTPRINT TO NEW SITES LOCATED AT EVACUATION CENTRES AND OTHER DESIGNATED RELIEF SITES TO MEET COMMUNITY NEEDS.

Projects.Title: FOUR CLANS CULTURAL DANCE AND MUSIC CELEBRATION
Projects.Description:
THE FOUR CLANS CULTURAL DANCE AND MUSIC PROJECT CELEBRATES THE CULTURAL IDENTITY OF BORROLOOLA THROUGH THE TRADITIONAL DANCE AND MUSIC OF THE REGION¿S FOUR CLANS ¿ YANYUWA, MARRA, GUDANJI AND GARRWA. AS A HIGHLIGHT OF THE MALANDARRI FESTIVAL, THESE CULTURAL DANCES WILL BRING TOGETHER ELDERS, FAMILIES AND YOUNG PEOPLE TO SHARE STORIES, SONG AND MOVEMENT PASSED DOWN THROUGH GENERATIONS. 

FOLLOWING THE TRADITIONAL PERFORMANCES, INDIGENOUS BANDS AND MUSICIANS WILL PERFORM FOR THE COMMUNITY.

Borroloola has a fully reticulated sewerage system.

PopulationIndicators.Comments: Proportion of households for whom rent payments were more than 30% of household income at the time of the Census.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Unemployment
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Unemployment rate (%) at the time of the Census. This is the number of unemployed persons expressed as a percentage of the total labour force. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Labour force participation
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Labour force participation rate (%) at the time of the Census. This is the number of unemployed persons expressed as a percentage of the total labour force. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Employment to population
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Employment to population rate (%) at the time of the Census. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of core activity need for assistance
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Number of people with a profound or severe core activity limitation. People with a profound or severe core activity limitation are those needing assistance in their day to day lives.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of long-term health conditions (per 1,000)
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Rates of long-term health conditions (per 1, 000 population). This measures the number of people who reported that they have been told by a doctor or nurse that they have any of these long-term health conditions.

Name: BULLA
Description: The community is situated on the Victoria Highway 340km west of Katherine. It is an excision from Auvergne Station. The nearest small town is Timber Creek, a distance of 60km east of Bulla Camp along the Victoria Highway. Kununurra is also within reasonable proximity being 170km to the west along the Victoria Highway and with the time differences between states is often a preferred location.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Bulla is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply.

Bulla has a limited groundwater source and a limited surface water source. Water quality is marginal. The water supply is filtered through sand, disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and monitored monthly for microbes.
Bulla has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Westside Kriol/ Ngarinyman
Victoria Daly Regional Council
Stuart
Bulla is located west of Katherine near Judbarra / Gregory National Park as a Community Living Area within the Auvergne Pastoral Property.

Name: CANTEEN CREEK
Description: The community is located approximately 275 kilometers south east of Tennant Creek. The community is located north east of the edge of the Davenport Ranges with the desert to the east. The first 85 kilometers is along the Stuart Highway and then 190 kilometers east along a gravel/dirt road. It takes 3 ? hours to drive from Tennant Ck. The road is poor in wet weather and subject to flooding.  The community is located adjacent to the Creek of the same name in open eucalypt and acacia woodlands.

Services.Comments: The community is located approx. 275 km south east of Tennant Creek. 85 km south along the Stuart Highway is the turn off, then 190 km east along a dirt road past Wutunugurra (Epenarra) community. It is approx. a 3.5 hours drive from Tennant Creek.

THIS PROJECT WILL ENHANCE SAFETY AND ACCESS FOR ALL USERS ESPECIALLY FOR DELIVERY OF ESSENTIAL SERVICES INCLUDING AERO-MEDICAL SERVICES.

Name: DAGURAGU
Description: The community is located approx 480 kms south west of Katherine on the Buntine Highway. The highway is a single lane bitumen road and is in a poor state of repair.

Services.Comments: Access to Daguragu from Katherine is via the Victoria and Buntine highways. The road is sealed between the Victoria Highway turnoff and Kalkarindji, with the section between Kalkarindji and the Western Australia border unsealed. Depending on weather and road conditions, it is about a five to six hours drive. Kalkarindji and Daguragu are about 8kms apart and connected by Daguragu Road, which is sealed. The Wattie Creek causeway can close for periods during the wet season, restricting access between Kalkarindji and Daguragu.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Kalkarindji/Daguragu is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply. Daguragu is connected to the Kalkarindji electricity grid.

Kalkarindji and Daguragu share the same groundwater source which has limited capacity but good quality water. The two communities have separate water supplies which are chlorinated and monitored monthly for microbes.
Kalkarindji and Daguragu have separate fully reticulated sewerage systems.
Gurindji / Kriol
Victoria Daly Regional Council
Stuart
Daguragu is located south west of Katherine, on the banks of Wattie Creek and near Kalkarindji on the Daguragu Aboriginal Land Trust.

HistoryDesc:
The town of Daly Waters is named after the adjoining stream feature named by John McDouall Stuart on 23 May 1862, during Stuart's sixth and successful attempt to cross the Continent from south to north.  
Daly Waters is named after Sir Dominick Daly who was the Governor of South Australia at the time.

The town of Daly Waters grew around the Daly Waters Depot, which later became the Telegraph Station (early 1872), and was surveyed in 1927 following the extension of the railway line to Birdum.  The townsite was  proclaimed in 1952.

Name: DARWIN
HistoryDesc:
The central business area of the city derives its name from the harbour which was named by Wickham and Stokes in 1839 after their former shipmate, Charles Darwin, who had been with them on a previous voyage in the "HMS Beagle".  

Surveyor-General Goyder when he established the settlement in 1869 named the town - Palmerston - but by 1900 this had reverted to Port Darwin and later to simply Darwin - since all communications were by sea, goods and passengers continued to be consigned to PORT DARWIN.   

In 1911, when the Commonwealth relieved the State of South Australia of the economic burden the Territory had become, DARWIN was adopted as the official name of the capital.

Projects.Title: MULTI-SPECIES MALARIA TRANSMISSION MODELLING TO INFORM POLICY DECISIONS
Projects.Description: MOST MALARIA CASES ARE CAUSED BY TWO PARASITE SPECIES. WHILE MANY COUNTRIES WITH MALARIA HAVE BOTH SPECIES, DECISIONS ABOUT TREATMENT AND CONTROL OF MALARIA RELY ON DATA AND MATHEMATICAL MODELS ON ONE SPECIES. WORKING WITH POLICY MAKERS, WE HAVE BUILT A NOVEL MODEL THAT INCLUDES BOTH SPECIES. THIS MODEL WILL EXPLORE HOW SPECIES INTERACT AND DETERMINE HOW TO ALLOCATE MONEY ON STRATEGIES THAT WILL MAXIMISE HEALTH BENEFITS, ENSURING THAT WE REACH MALARIA ELIMINATION AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE.

Projects.Description: A SIGNIFICANT PORTION OF AVIATION GROUND HANDLING STAFF HAVE NOT WORKED SINCE MARCH 2020 AND DUE TO THIS LONG PERIOD OF NEGLIGIBLE FLYING ACTIVITY, THE GROUND HANDLING WORKFORCE ARE LIKELY TO REQUIRE RETRAINING AND REACCREDITATION TO ENSURE SAFETY STANDARDS ARE MAINTAINED FOR ALL FLIGHTS. THE CAPPED GRANTS WILL NOT COVER THE COMPLETE TRAINING REQUIREMENTS OF ALL EMPLOYEES.

Projects.Title: IMPROVING MICROVASCULAR DYSFUNCTION IN FALCIPARUM MALARIA
Projects.Description: ADDITIONAL TREATMENTS ARE NEEDED TO REDUCE GLOBAL MALARIA MORTALITY. IN HOSPITALISED PATIENTS WITH FALCIPARUM MALARIA WE WILL EVALUATE NEW METHODS OF ASSESSING BLOOD VESSEL DYSFUNCTION IN MALARIA. WE WILL USE THESE METHODS TO CONDUCT A TRIAL OF THE SAFETY AND EFFICACY OF SODIUM NITRITE, A WIDELY AVAILABLE DRUG WITH THE POTENTIAL TO TREAT MALARIA BY INCREASING NITRIC OXIDE AND IMPROVING BLOOD FLOW. OUR RESULTS WILL INFORM THE DESIGN OF A LARGER STUDY OF SODIUM NITRITE TO TREAT SEVERE MALARIA.

Projects.Title: ENSURING PROVISION OF ESSENTIAL PRIMARY HEALTH CARE SERVICES
Projects.Description: THE COMMONWEALTH HEALTH WORKFORCE PROGRAM DELIVERS HEATH WORKFORCE OUTCOMES AND SUPPORT FOR RURAL OUTREACH HEALTH SERVICES. THE HEALTH WORKFORCE PROGRAM IS DELIVERED UNDER THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND AGED CARE&RSQUO;S OUTCOME 1.4 &NDASH; HEALTH WORKFORCE. THIS OUTCOME IS INTENDED TO IMPROVE IMPROVE THE QUALITY, DISTRIBUTION AND PLANNING OF THE AUSTRALIAN HEALTH WORKFORCE TO BETTER MEET THE NEEDS OF THE COMMUNITY AND DELIVER A SUSTAINABLE, WELL DISTRIBUTED HEALTH WORKFORCE. IN THE 2022-23 BUDGET, THE AUSTRALIAN GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCED A LANDMARK LONG-TERM ENGAGEMENT WITH THE ROYAL FLYING DOCTOR SERVICE (RFDS OF AUSTRALIA). THIS ANNOUNCEMENT COMPRISES OF THIS &LSQUO;ENSURING PROVISION OF ESSENTIAL PRIMARY HEALTH CARE SERVICES IN RURAL AND REMOTE AUSTRALIA&RSQUO; PROGRAM, A 10-YEAR STRATEGIC AGREEMENT AND UP TO APPROXIMATELY $1 BILLION OVER A PERIOD OF UP TO TEN YEARS TO PROVIDE ESSENTIAL PRIMARY HEALTH CARE SERVICES AND AEROMEDICAL EVACUATIONS FOR RURAL AND REMOTE PATIENTS IN AREAS OF MARKET FAILURE OR BEYOND WHERE NORMAL MEDICAL INFRASTRUCTURE WOULD OTHERWISE PROVIDE SERVICES. THIS INCLUDES REFORM OF THE COMMONWEALTH&RSQUO;S PARTNERSHIP WITH THE RFDS OF AUSTRALIA TO INCLUDE COLLABORATIVE ANNUAL SERVICE PLANNING, AND INCREASED FLEXIBILITY AND RESPONSIVENESS IN FUNDING ALLOCATION AND SERVICE LEVELS TO ENSURE HEALTH SERVICES ARE DELIVERED TO THOSE COMMUNITIES MOST IN NEED, IN RURAL AND REMOTE AUSTRALIA.&NBSP;&NBSP;

PARTICIPANTS VISIT STATIONS TO TAKE THEIR OWN BIOMEDICAL MEASURES AND ENGAGE IN DISCUSSIONS WITH HEALTH SCIENCE PROFESSIONALS ABOUT REDUCING THEIR RISK OF CHRONIC DISEASE. PARTICIPANTS CAN USE INTERACTIVE TECHNOLOGY AND TALK TO SCIENTISTS, HEALTH PROFESSIONALS AND ABORIGINAL AND TORRES STRAIT ISLANDER TRAINEES ABOUT THE SCIENCE BEHIND THE INNER WORKINGS OF THE HUMAN BODY, THE TECHNOLOGY BEHIND THE EQUIPMENT WE USE, AND EXCITING CAREERS IN SCIENCE.

Projects.Title: THE AIM OF THE GRANT PROGRAM IS TO ASSIST THE DOMESTIC AIRLINE INDUSTRY IN RESPONSE TO THE ECONOMIC PRESSURES CREATED BY THE IMPACT OF COVID-19 BY REDUCING OPERATIONAL COST PRESSURES TO IMPROVE THE ABILITY TO MAINTAIN SERVICES.
Projects.Description: THE GOVERNMENT IS PROVIDING FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE WITH MEASURES TO EASE THE COSTS AND CHARGES OF OPERATING COMMERCIAL AIR SERVICES FROM 1 FEBRUARY TO 31 DECEMBER 2020. THE MEASURES INCLUDE A REBATE OF FUEL EXCISE, DOMESTIC AVIATION SECURITY CHARGES REBATE, OFFSETTING INCREASED OPERATIONAL COSTS FROM SCHEDULED ENHANCED REGIONAL SECURITY SCREENING REQUIREMENTS. THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROGRAM IS TO REDUCE THE COST BASE FACED BY COMMERCIAL AIRLINES, IMPROVING THE FINANCIAL VIABILITY OF SCHEDULED AND COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS.

Projects.Description: 1.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; THE PURPOSE OF THE GRANT IS TO: A.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; DRIVE MORE DOMESTIC TOURISTS TO TRAVEL TO KEY NOMINATED REGIONS THAT HAVE SUFFERED SIGNIFICANT ADVERSE IMPACTS FROM THE LOSS OF INTERNATIONAL TOURISTS; B.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; SUPPORT JOBS WITHIN THE AUSTRALIAN TOURISM INDUSTRY BY HAVING AN ECONOMIC MULTIPLIER EFFECT, AS TRAVELLERS SPEND MONEY ON ACCOMMODATION, FOOD AND ACTIVITIES IN THESE REGIONS; C.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; SUPPORT JOBS IN THE AVIATION INDUSTRY BY INCREASING THE NETWORK FOOTPRINTS OF AIRLINES OPERATING THESE DOMESTIC TOURISM ROUTES, AND THEREFORE INCREASING THE NUMBER OF AIRLINE WORKERS STAFFING AND SERVICING THE AIRCRAFT, AS WELL AS WORKERS IN ASSOCIATED GROUND HANDLING SERVICES AND AIRPORTS; D.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; REDUCE THE COST TO CONSUMERS OF FLYING ON NOMINATED ROUTES BY REDUCING TICKET PRICES FOR FLIGHTS TAKEN DURING THE PERIOD FROM 1&NBSP;APRIL&NBSP;2021 TO 30 SEPTEMBER 2021 (INCLUSIVE) TO DESIGNATED REGIONS THAT ARE HEAVILY RELIANT ON TOURISM (TANS GRANT PART 1); AND E.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; INCREASE THE NUMBER OF FLIGHTS ABOVE MINIMUM CONNECTIVITY ON NOMINATED ROUTES (CREATING TOURISM AVIATION SURGE CAPACITY) DURING THE SAME PERIOD (TANS GRANT PART 2A AND TANS GRANT PART 2B).

Projects.Title: THE PROGRAM WILL PROVIDE CAPPED GRANTS TO ELIGIBLE BUSINESSES TO CONTRIBUTE TO MANDATORY TRAINING, CERTIFICATION, AND ACCREDITATION OF GROUND HANDLING WORKERS ESSENTIAL FOR THE OPERATION OF AIRCRAFT.
Projects.Description: A SIGNIFICANT PORTION OF AVIATION GROUND HANDLING STAFF HAVE NOT WORKED SINCE MARCH 2020 AND DUE TO THIS LONG PERIOD OF NEGLIGIBLE FLYING ACTIVITY, THE GROUND HANDLING WORKFORCE ARE LIKELY TO REQUIRE RETRAINING AND REACCREDITATION TO ENSURE SAFETY STANDARDS ARE MAINTAINED FOR ALL FLIGHTS. THE GRANT CONTRIBUTION WILL SET A FLOOR TO ENSURE THAT THE SECTOR IS IN A POSITION TO RESPOND AS DOMESTIC FLYING ACTIVITY RECOVERS. IT IS ANTICIPATED THAT THE PROGRAM WILL COVER APPROXIMATELY 30% OF THE TRAINING REQUIREMENTS OF THE PRE-COVID WORKFORCE. TRAINING SUPPORT WOULD BE AVAILABLE FOR BOTH NEW AND EXISTING EMPLOYEES, AS REQUIRED TO SUPPORT AVIATION RECOVERY. THE CAPPED GRANTS WILL NOT COVER THE COMPLETE TRAINING REQUIREMENTS OF ALL EMPLOYEES.

Projects.Title: INDIGENIST ARCHAEOLOGY: NEW WAYS OF KNOWING THE PAST AND PRESENT
Projects.Description: THIS PROJECT AIMS TO EXPLORE HOW INDIGENOUS AUSTRALIAN WORLDVIEWS CAN TRANSFORM ARCHAEOLOGICAL PRACTICE AND UNDERSTANDINGS OF THE PAST. ARCHAEOLOGICAL RESEARCH PRACTICE HAS TYPICALLY RELIED ON WESTERN SCIENCE, THEORIES AND INTERPRETIVE FRAMEWORKS. AS AN ALTERNATIVE APPROACH, WE WILL DEVELOP A NEW EPISTEMOLOGICAL CONCEPTUALISATION FOR HOW ARCHAEOLOGY CAN BE PRACTICED. BASED ON SURVEYS AND INTERVIEWS WITH SIX ABORIGINAL COMMUNITIES IN THE NORTHERN TERRITORY AND SOUTH AUSTRALIA, AND USING INDIGENOUS THEORIES AND CONCEPTS, THE PROJECT WILL IDENTIFY AND EXPLORE HOW ABORIGINAL WAYS OF KNOWING (EPISTEMOLOGY), BEING (ONTOLOGY) AND DOING (AXIOLOGY) CAN BE INTEGRATED INTO A NEW MODEL FOR ARCHAEOLOGICAL RESEARCH THAT WE CALL Â€ŒINDIGENIST ARCHAEOLOGYÂ€.

Projects.Title: NOVEL GENETIC TOOLS FOR TRACKING THE ORIGINS AND SPREAD OF PLASMODIUM VIVAX
Projects.Description: PLASMODIUM VIVAX CAUSES GREATER THAN8 MILLION MALARIA CASES ANNUALLY. CONTAINMENT OF THIS PARASITE IS CONSTRAINED BY LIMITED SURVEILLANCE TOOLS. THIS PROJECT WILL ESTABLISH GENETIC DATA ON GREATER THAN6,000 P. VIVAX CASES FROM ACROSS THE GLOBE. USING THIS DATA, WE WILL DEVELOP AN ONLINE PLATFORM WITH ANALYTICAL TOOLS TO IDENTIFY THE MAIN RESERVOIRS OF INFECTION, HOW PARASITES ARE SPREADING WITHIN AND ACROSS NATIONAL BORDERS, AND HOW EFFECTIVELY INTERVENTIONS HAVE IMPACTED ON PARASITE TRANSMISSION.

Projects.Title: LOW OXYGEN INTERVENTION FOR CARDIAC ARREST INJURY LIMITATION TRIAL (LOGICAL)
Projects.Description: LIFE SUPPORT WITH MECHANICAL VENTILATION (MV) IS REQUIRED FOR MOST PATIENTS AFTER CARDIAC ARREST. DELIVERY OF LIBERAL OXYGEN THERAPY TO PATIENTS RECEIVING MV IS STANDARD CARE AND EXPOSES THEM TO A HIGH OXYGEN DOSE AND HIGHER BLOOD OXYGEN LEVELS. A HIGHER AMOUNT OF OXYGEN MIGHT BE HARMFUL AFTER CARDIAC ARREST, BUT THE OPTIMAL OXYGEN THERAPY IN THESE PATIENTS IS UNCERTAIN. THIS STUDY TESTS STANDARD CARE VERSUS A PROTECTIVE CONSERVATIVE DOSE OF OXYGEN ON NEUROLOGICAL RECOVERY AFTER CARDIAC ARREST.

Projects.Title: CHANGE OF G6PD ACTIVITY IN THE COURSE OF MALARIA
Projects.Description: MALARIA IS A SERIOUS AND POTENTIALLY DEADLY DISEASE. FOLLOWING A FIRST SYMPTOMATIC PHASE, SOME MALARIA SPECIES DEVELOP ASYMPTOMATIC FORMS THAT CAUSE A SECOND SYMPTOMATIC PHASE WEEKS TO MONTHS AFTER THE FIRST EPISODE. THE DRUGS CURRENTLY USED TO TREAT THIS MALARIA SPECIES CAN CAUSE SEVERE SIDE EFFECTS IN PEOPLE WITH LOW ACTIVITIES OF A PARTICULAR ENZYME (G6PD). THIS PROJECT WILL TEST WHETHER G6PD LEVELS INCREASE DURING A MALARIA ATTACK, RENDERING TREATMENT MUCH SAFER THAN WHAT IS ASSUMED TO DATE.

Projects.Title: SKIN MICROBES AND ANIMAL HEALTH: UNDERSTANDING THE ECOLOGICAL CONTEXT
Projects.Description: THIS PROJECT AIMS TO UNDERSTAND THE FUNDAMENTAL ECOLOGICAL RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN ANIMAL HOSTS (FROGS, GECKOS) AND BACTERIA ON THEIR SKIN BY SEPARATING HOST EFFECTS FROM ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS THAT DETERMINE SKIN MICROBIOME COMPOSITION. THE RESEARCH IS SIGNIFICANT BECAUSE IT WILL GENERATE NEW KNOWLEDGE NEEDED TO UNDERSTAND HOW SKIN MICROBES FUNCTION IN PROVIDING PROTECTION AGAINST DISEASE. EXPECTED OUTCOMES INCLUDE THE PROVISION OF ESSENTIAL INFORMATION THAT WILL GUIDE FUTURE RESEARCH EFFORTS ON THE FACTORS THAT DETERMINE A HEALTHY SKIN MICROBIAL COMMUNITY (WHICH IS NEEDED BEFORE SKIN DISEASES CAN BE COMBATED). THE RESEARCH WILL PROVIDE SIGNIFICANT BENEFITS, INCLUDING MORE TARGETED CONSERVATION EFFORTS TO COMBAT WILDLIFE SKIN DISEASES.
Projects.TagsDisplayName: SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, ENGINEERING AND MATHEMATICS (STEM) RESEARCH

Projects.Title: INVESTING IN ABORIGINAL LANGUAGES
Projects.Description: WE WILL DEVELOP THE FIRST SYSTEMATIC ACCOUNT OF ABORIGINAL LANGUAGE PROGRAMS AND WHAT MAKES THEM EFFECTIVE AND SUSTAINABLE. THE PROJECT WILL CREATE A SUBSTANTIAL EVIDENCE BASE, LEADING TO A COMPREHENSIVE MODEL OF LANGUAGE REVITALISATION AND HOW IT OPERATES IN EACH PLACE, AND FOR WHOM. THE MODEL WILL SHOW HOW LOCAL AND NATIONAL ORGANISATIONS CAN INVEST IN ABORIGINAL LANGUAGES, AND WHAT KINDS OF RETURNS THEY CAN EXPECT. THE PROJECT INVOLVES A TWO-WAY COLLABORATION WITH ABORIGINAL PEOPLE ACROSS THE COUNTRY THAT WILL ELEVATE THEIR VOICES AND BUILD THEIR CAPACITY FOR DESIGNING AND EVALUATING PROGRAMS, BUSINESSES AND TECHNOLOGIES FOR KEEPING ABORIGINAL LANGUAGES STRONG.

Projects.Title: ADDRESSING THE THREAT OF EMERGING ZOONOTIC MALARIA IN OUR REGION
Projects.Description: THE MONKEY MALARIA PARASITE P. KNOWLESI (PK) INCREASINGLY INFECTS HUMANS ACROSS SOUTHEAST ASIA. A MULTIDISCIPLINARY APPROACH WILL EVALUATE WHY PK CASES ARE RISING, IMPROVE LABORATORY DETECTION METHODS, ASSESS PREVENTATIVE TREATMENTS, AND INFORM PUBLIC HEALTH PROGRAMS. PK GENETIC ANALYSES WILL EXPLORE CAUSES OF SEVERE DISEASE AND GEOGRAPHICAL INFECTION PATTERNS. EVALUATING HUMAN INTERACTION WITH MOSQUITOS, MONKEYS, AND LAND-USE, WILL GENERATE REGIONAL PK RISK PREDICTION MAPS FOR TARGETED CONTROL.

Projects.Title: A NOVEL USE OF STERILE WATER FOR INJECTION TO RELIEVE PAIN IN LABOUR
Projects.Description: MEDICAL PAIN RELIEF OPTIONS FOR LABOUR HAVE CHANGED LITTLE IN 50 YEARS. WHILE EPIDURALS ARE EFFECTIVE OTHER OPTIONS SUCH AS OPIOIDS OR (LAUGHING) GAS ARE OFTEN INEFFECTIVE AND ALL COME WITH UNWANTED SIDE EFFECTS. OUR PLACEBO-CONTROLLED TRIAL WILL TEST THE USE OF INJECTIONS OF STERILE WATER TO RELIEVE CONTRACTION PAIN IN LABOUR; PROVEN BY OUR TEAM AS SAFE AND EFFECTIVE FOR BACK PAIN IN LABOUR. IF SUCCESSFUL THE TRIAL WILL PROVIDE A SIMPLE AND SAFE CHOICE FOR LABOUR PAIN RELIEF.

Projects.Title: STAFFING PRACTICES IN ABORIGINAL PRIMARY HEALTH CARE SERVICES
Projects.Description: THIS PROJECT AIMS TO GENERATE NEW KNOWLEDGE ABOUT THE IMPACT OF SHORT-TERM STAFFING IN REMOTE ABORIGINAL COMMUNITY CONTROLLED HEALTH SERVICES ON SERVICE ACCEPTABILITY TO PATIENTS, WORKLOAD AND ATTITUDES OF LONG-TERM STAFF AND THE EFFECTIVENESS AND COST OF SERVICES. Projects.Title: THE TWO HEARTS BEAT STUDY: DETERMINING THE BENEFITS AND BARRIERS OF ECHOCARDIOGRAPHIC SCREENING IN PREGNANCY FOR INDIGENOUS WOMEN IN THE TOP END OF THE NORTHERN TERRITORY
Projects.Description: THE TWO HEARTS BEAT PROJECT IS A NOVEL STUDY UTILISING TECHNOLOGY AND MULTI-DISCIPLINARY CARE TO IMPROVE HEALTH OUTCOMES FOR INDIGENOUS PREGNANT WOMEN LIVING IN THE TOP END OF THE NORTHERN TERRITORY. IN THIS STUDY A HEART ULTRASOUND SCAN WILL BE INTEGRATED INTO STANDARD ANTENATAL CARE. THE SCAN WILL SCREEN FOR RHD AND OTHER HEART DISEASE THAT MAY IMPACT THE PREGNANCY, DETERMINING THE RATES OF RHD IN THIS POPULATION. THE ACCEPTABILITY, COST AND IMPACT OF THIS INITIATIVE WILL BE DETERMINED.

Projects.Title: INTERMITTENT PREVENTIVE TREATMENT IN PREGNANCY WITH SULPHADOXINE-PYRIMETHAMINE PLUS DIHYDROARTEMISININ-PIPERAQUINE TO REDUCE ADVERSE PREGNANCY OUTCOMES AND PREVENT MALARIA IN PAPUA NEW GUINEA: A RANDOMISED CONTROLLED TRIAL
Projects.Description: MILLIONS OF PREGNANCIES ARE COMPLICATED BY MALARIA WORLDWIDE. MONTHLY SULPHADOXINE-PYRIMETHAMINE (SP) TREATMENTS, THE CURRENT TREATMENT STRATEGY, NO LONGER PROTECTS FROM MALARIA BUT IMPROVES BIRTH OUTCOMES THROUGH NON-MALARIAL EFFECTS. DIHYDROARTEMISININ-PIPERAQUINE CLEARS MALARIA BUT BABIES ARE SMALLER COMPARED TO WOMEN WHO RECEIVED SP. A CLINICAL TRIAL OF THEIR COMBINATION HAS POTENTIAL TO SUBSTANTIALLY IMPROVE HEALTH OUTCOMES FOR WOMEN AND BABIES IN PAPUA NEW GUINEA AND BEYOND.

Projects.Description: 1.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; THE PURPOSE OF THE GRANT IS TO: A.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; DRIVE MORE DOMESTIC TOURISTS TO TRAVEL TO KEY NOMINATED REGIONS THAT HAVE SUFFERED SIGNIFICANT ADVERSE IMPACTS FROM THE LOSS OF INTERNATIONAL TOURISTS; B.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; SUPPORT JOBS WITHIN THE AUSTRALIAN TOURISM INDUSTRY BY HAVING AN ECONOMIC MULTIPLIER EFFECT, AS TRAVELLERS SPEND MONEY ON ACCOMMODATION, FOOD AND ACTIVITIES IN THESE REGIONS; C.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; SUPPORT JOBS IN THE AVIATION INDUSTRY BY INCREASING THE NETWORK FOOTPRINTS OF AIRLINES OPERATING THESE DOMESTIC TOURISM ROUTES, AND THEREFORE INCREASING THE NUMBER OF AIRLINE WORKERS STAFFING AND SERVICING THE AIRCRAFT, AS WELL AS WORKERS IN ASSOCIATED GROUND HANDLING SERVICES AND AIRPORTS; D.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; REDUCE THE COST TO CONSUMERS OF FLYING ON NOMINATED ROUTES BY REDUCING TICKET PRICES FOR FLIGHTS TAKEN DURING THE PERIOD FROM 1&NBSP;APRIL&NBSP;2021 TO 30 SEPTEMBER 2021 (INCLUSIVE) TO DESIGNATED REGIONS THAT ARE HEAVILY RELIANT ON TOURISM (TANS GRANT PART 1); AND E.&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP;&NBSP; INCREASE THE NUMBER OF FLIGHTS ABOVE MINIMUM CONNECTIVITY ON NOMINATED ROUTES (CREATING TOURISM AVIATION SURGE CAPACITY) DURING THE SAME PERIOD (TANS GRANT PART 2A AND TANS GRANT PART 2B).

A PLAN OF MANAGEMENT AND ASSOCIATED MERI FRAMEWORK WILL BE DEVELOPED FOR THE PROPOSED IPA IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE &LSQUO;OUR COUNTRY OUR WAY: GUIDELINES 2016 &RSQUO; FOR AUSTRALIAN IPA MANAGEMENT PLANS AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PROTECTED AREA MANAGEMENT CATEGORIES OUTLINED BY THE INTERNATIONAL UNION FOR CONSERVATION OF NATURE (IUCN). Projects.Title: HTLV-1 VIROLOGY AND PATHOGENESIS
Projects.Description: HTLV-1 IS A LIFELONG INFECTION OF IMMUNE CELLS THAT SUSTAINS HIGH INFECTION RATES UP TO 45 PERCENT IN KEY AUSTRALIAN COMMUNITIES. DESPITE HTLV-1 CAUSING SERIOUS MALIGNANCY AND INFLAMMATORY CO-MORBIDITIES THAT SHORTEN LIFESPAN, FEW BIOMEDICAL INTERVENTIONS ARE AVAILABLE. WE WILL EXAMINE HOW THE VIRUS GROWS AND ALTERS IMMUNE RESPONSES TO CAUSE DISEASE. WITH THIS, WE CAN DEVELOP ANTIVIRAL TREATMENTS TO REDUCE VIRUS INFECTED CELLS, AND MAKE NEW DIAGNOSTIC BIOMARKER ASSAYS SUITABLE FOR REMOTE SETTINGS.

Projects.Description: HOW FOOD IS PROMOTED, PRICED AND MADE AVAILABLE IN FOOD RETAIL HAS CONSIDERABLE IMPACT ON CONSUMER BEHAVIOUR AND SUBSEQUENTLY POPULATION HEALTH. Projects.Title: ORAL BACTERIAL LYSATE TO PREVENT PERSISTENT WHEEZE IN INFANTS AFTER SEVERE BRONCHIOLITIS; A RANDOMISED PLACEBO CONTROLLED TRIAL (BLIPA; BACTERIAL LYSATE IN PREVENTING ASTHMA)
Projects.Description: PREVENTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF WHEEZE IN PRESCHOOL CHILDREN WOULD PRODUCE MAJOR HEALTH BENEFITS, BUT TO DATE NO THERAPIES HAVE PROVED TO BE EFFECTIVE. A GROUP OF INFANTS WHO ARE AT VERY HIGH RISK OF DEVELOPING PRESCHOOL WHEEZE AND SUBSEQUENT ASTHMA, ARE INFANTS WHO ARE HOSPITALISED WITH BRONCHIOLITS. WE ARE PARTNERING LEADERS IN THE UNITED KINGDOM IN THIS STUDY WHICH WILL EXAMINE WHETHER BOOSTING THE IMMUNE SYSTEM BY GIVING GRANULES OF LYSED DEAD BACTERIA CAN PREVENT FUTURE CHILDHOOD ASTHMA.

OUR MRFF ENCOMPASSES AUSTRALIA'S MOST ADVANCED COVID-19 IMMUNOLOGY PROGRAM WHICH WILL DEFINE PROTECTIVE AND LONG-LASTING IMMUNITY AGAINST SARS-COV-2 AND DELINEATE DETRIMENTAL IMMUNOPATHOLOGY IN COVID-19. OUR IN-DEPTH IMMUNE STUDIES IN WIDE RANGING COHORTS WILL PROVIDE KEY INSIGHTS INTO THE RATIONAL DESIGN OF VACCINES AND THERAPIES TO LIMIT DISEASE SPREAD AND PROTECT HIGH-RISK GROUPS.

Projects.Title: MANAGE AND OVERSEE THE DFAT QUAD TECH NETWORK (QTN)
Projects.Description: DFAT'S CYBER AFFAIRS AND CRITICAL TECHNOLOGY BRANCH IS SEEKING TO ESTABLISH A QUAD TECH NETWORK (QTN), TO SUPPORT AND COMPLEMENT THE DEVELOPMENT OF AUSTRALIA'S FIRST CYBER AND CRITICAL TECHNOLOGY INTERNATIONAL ENGAGEMENT STRATEGY (CCTIES). THE PUBLIC-FACING CCTIES IS SCHEDULE DOT BE RELEASED IN LATE 2020 AND WILL EXPAND ON AND SUPERSEDE THE OBJECTIVES OF THE 2017 INTERNATIONAL CYBER ENGAGEMENT STRATEGY (ICES) TO INCLUDE BOTH CYBER AND CRITICAL TECHNOLOGY ISSUES. AS PART OF THIS PROCESS, THE QTN WILL SUPPORT RESEARCH AND PROMOTE ENGAGEMENT WITH ACADEMIC AND THINK TANK PARTNERS ON CYBER AND CRITICAL TECHNOLOGY ISSUES THAT REFLECT AUSTRALIA'S INTERESTS AS A LIBERAL DEMOCRACY COMMITTED TO THE INTERNATIONAL RULES-BASED ORDER. THE QTN IS INTENDED TO PRODUCE POLICY-RELEVANT RESEARCH AND RECOMMENDATIONS RELEVANT TO AUSTRALIA'S NATIONAL INTERESTS ACROSS THE BREADTH OF CYBER AFFAIRS AND CRITICAL TECHNOLOGY ISSUES; DEEPEN AND STRENGTHEN PUBLIC UNDERSTANDING OF THESE ISSUES; AND PROMOTE INFORMED PUBLIC DIALOGUE. THE PROJECT WILL ALSO PROVIDE THE OPPORTUNITY FOR CYBER AFFAIRS AND CRITICAL TECHNOLOGY BRANCH TO LEVERAGE THE EXPERTISE OF THE QTN PROJECT PARTNERS THROUGH THE FACILITATION OF PRIVATE VIDEO TELECONFERENCE CALLS. THE QTN&NBSP; WILL INCLUDE ACADEMIC OR THINK-TANK INSTIUTUTIONS FROM COUNTRIES INVOLVED IN THE QUADRILATERAL SECURITY DIALOGUE (QUAD): AUSTRALIA, INDIA, JAPAN AND THE UNITED STATES. THE QTN WILL BE MANAGED BY THE AUSTRALIAN NATIONAL UNIVERSITY ON BEHALF OF DFAT. ANU WILL ACT AS THE PRIMARY POINT OF CONTACT FOR THE QTN, MANAGE AND OVERSEE THE DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROJECT, AND MANAGE THE SUB-CONTRACTING OF THE OTHER PROJECT PARTNERS (ANU'S NATIONAL SECURITY COLLEGE; THE OBSERVER RESEARCH FOUNDATION; CENTRE FOR A NEW AMERICA SECURITY; AND THE NATIONAL GRADUATE INSTITUTE FOR POLICY STUDIES). ANU WILL ALSO FACILITATE 12 VIDEO TELECONFERENCE CALLS BETWEEN DFAT AND THE PROJECT PARTNERS; MANAGE THE PUBLICATION OF FOUR RESEARCH PAPERS BETWEEN 10 AND 15,000 WORDS EACH; AND ARRANGE AN ONLINE LAUNCH EVENT FOR THE QTN, IN CONJUNCTION WITH DFAT. ANU WILL WORK WITH DFAT ON THE BRANDING OF THE PROJECT, INCLUDING COMMUNICATION AND MEDIA THROUGHOUT THE PROJECT. Projects.Title: THE PROGRAM PROVIDES ELIGIBLE DOMESTIC REGIONAL PUBLIC TRANSPORT (RPT) AIRLINES OPERATING INTERSTATE SERVICES SUPPORT TO PRESERVE CRITICAL OPERATIONAL CAPABILITIES IN PREPAREDNESS FOR AVIATION RECOVERY.
Projects.Description: THE DOMESTIC AIRLINE INDUSTRY CONTINUES TO BE VULNERABLE TO THE DISRUPTIVE EFFECTS OF SUDDEN COVID-19 OUTBREAKS AND THE IMPOSITION OF UNEXPECTED BORDER RESTRICTIONS AND STAY-AT-HOME ORDERS.&NBSP; &NBSP; THE NUMEROUS COVID-19 OUTBREAKS ACROSS THE COUNTRY SINCE LATE MAY 2021 HAS SEEN INCREASING DOMESTIC TRAVEL RESTRICTIONS, RESULTING IN SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCED DOMESTIC AVIATION ACTIVITY.&NBSP; &NBSP; AS A CRITICAL INDUSTRY RESPONSIBLE FOR CONNECTING AUSTRALIA, THE IMPACTS OF THESE KINDS OF SHOCKS CAN BE FELT ACROSS THE BROADER ECONOMY, AND COULD POTENTIALLY STIFLE AUSTRALIA&RSQUO;S ECONOMIC RECOVERY. IT IS IMPORTANT THAT DURING THESE PERIODS OF COMMONWEALTH CHIEF MEDICAL OFFICER (CMO) HOT SPOT DECLARATIONS, DOMESTIC AIRLINE CAPABILITY IS RETAINED SO THAT DOMESTIC AIRLINES HAVE THE CAPACITY TO EFFECTIVELY AND QUICKLY RESPOND TO CHALLENGES.&NBSP; &NBSP; THE GRANT WILL ALLOW DOMESTIC REGULAR PUBLIC TRANSPORT (RPT) AIRLINES OPERATING INTERSTATE SERVICES WHICH SUFFER FROM ACTIVITY REDUCTIONS FOLLOWING A COMMONWEALTH CMO HOT SPOT DECLARATION :&NBSP; &BULL; TO QUICKLY AND EFFECTIVELY RESPOND TO SUDDEN CHANGES IN ACTIVITY AND DEMAND THROUGHOUT RECOVERY,&NBSP; &BULL; RETAIN CRITICAL AIRLINE SKILLS, AND &BULL; PRESERVE JOBS ACROSS THE DOMESTIC AIRLINE SECTOR. &NBSP;

Projects.Title: TRADE ROUTES
Projects.Description: THIS EXHIBITION TELLS ONE OF THE GREAT UNTOLD STORIES OF THE AUSTRALIAN CONTINENT AND ABORIGINAL CIVILISATION &ACIRC;&EURO;&LDQUO; ABORIGINAL TRADE ROUTES. THESE TRADE ROUTES ARE THE &ACIRC;&EURO;&TILDE;SILK ROAD OF THE SOUTH&ACIRC;&EURO;™, ALTHOUGH VASTLY DIFFERENT ECONOMICALLY IN THEIR MODALITIES AND ORGANISATION OF EXCHANGE. THEY ARE, AS A FINE MESH OF LOCALLY NUANCED EXCHANGES, AN ACCUMULATION OF ECONOMIC AND CULTURAL EXCHANGE THAT SHAPED AUSTRALIA&ACIRC;&EURO;™S HISTORY. THESE VAST SYSTEMS, SUCH AS WUNAN IN THE KIMBERLEY, THE NGIA-NGIAMPE OF THE NGARRINDJERI AND MURRAY RIVER GROUPS, AND LOCALISED CONCEPTS INCLUDING GERRI IN ARNHEM LAND, REVEAL NOT ONLY ECONOMIC BUT CULTURAL STRUCTURES OF ABORIGINAL AUSTRALIA.

Projects.Title: THE ECOLOGICAL IMPACT OF LARGE CARNIVORE RESTORATION
Projects.Description: THIS PROJECT AIMS TO ASSESS THE ECOLOGICAL CHANGES THAT HAVE ARISEN DUE TO THE REPATRIATION OF ESTUARINE CROCODILES TO AUSTRALIAN ECOSYSTEMS. IT IS SIGNIFICANT BECAUSE THE RESTORATION PROVIDES A RARE OPPORTUNITY TO EMPIRICALLY TEST CHANGES IN ECOSYSTEM PROCESSES UNDER VARYING DEGREES OF LARGE CARNIVORE PREDATION PRESSURE. EXPECTED OUTCOMES INCLUDE IMPROVED UNDERSTANDING OF THE PROCESSES THAT GOVERN THE STRENGTH OF PREDATOR-ECOSYSTEM INTERACTIONS AND AN ABILITY TO QUANTIFY THE BIOMASS, SOCIAL STRUCTURE, AND BEHAVIOURS OF PREDATORS REQUIRED TO INFLUENCE THESE PROCESSES. BENEFITS SHOULD INCLUDE IMPROVEMENTS IN HOW THE ECOLOGICAL ROLE OF LARGE CARNIVORES IS MEASURED, AND WHEN AND WHERE CARNIVORE POPULATIONS SHOULD BE CULLED OR CONSERVED.

Projects.Title: BREATHING STREAMS: INTEGRATING AQUATIC EMISSIONS INTO CARBON BUDGETS
Projects.Description: THIS PROJECT AIMS TO DETERMINE THE AMOUNT OF GREENHOUSE GASES EMITTED BY SMALL STREAMS ACROSS THE AUSTRALIAN TROPICS, A POTENTIAL HOTSPOT FOR EMISSIONS OF CARBON DIOXIDE AND METHANE. THE PROJECT EXPECTS TO INVESTIGATE THE CONTROLS ON GASEOUS EMISSIONS FROM STREAM TO REGIONAL SCALES USING A NOVEL COMBINATION OF GAS TRACER EXPERIMENTS, REMOTE SENSING TECHNIQUES AND MACHINE LEARNING ALGORITHMS. EXPECTED OUTCOMES INCLUDE THE DEVELOPMENT OF A PREDICTIVE MODEL OF GAS EXCHANGE AND THE FIRST ESTIMATE OF GASEOUS EMISSIONS FROM THE AUSTRALIAN TROPICS. THIS SHOULD PROVIDE SIGNIFICANT BENEFITS SUCH AS REDUCING UNCERTAINTIES ON THE NATIONAL CARBON BUDGET AND AVOIDING MISALIGNMENT OF GREENHOUSE GAS ABATEMENT POLICIES.

Projects.Description: THIS PROJECT AIMS TO RECTIFY THE AUSTRALIAN CARBON BALANCE BY DETERMINING THE AMOUNT OF TERRESTRIAL CARBON THAT IS LOST TO STREAMS AND RIVERS ACROSS THE COUNTRY. THROUGH A NOVEL INTEGRATION OF HIGH-RESOLUTION HYDROCHEMICAL AND GAS MEASUREMENTS, REMOTE SENSING AND MACHINE LEARNING ALGORITHMS, THE PROJECT INTENDS TO GENERATE NEW KNOWLEDGE ABOUT THE LINKS BETWEEN TERRESTRIAL CARBON SEQUESTRATION AND AQUATIC CARBON EXPORT. EXPECTED OUTCOMES INCLUDE A REFINED ESTIMATE OF THE NET CARBON SEQUESTRATION POTENTIAL ACROSS AUSTRALIAN BIOMES AND SEASONS. THIS SHOULD PROVIDE SIGNIFICANT BENEFITS SUCH AS AVOIDING MISALIGNMENT OF GREENHOUSE GAS ABATEMENT POLICIES AND ADVANCING CARBON CYCLING MODELS AND PREDICTIONS.

Projects.Title: INDIVIDUALISED BLOOD PRESSURE TARGETS VERSUS STANDARD CARE AMONG CRITICALLY ILL PATIENTS WITH SHOCK - A MULTICENTRE RANDOMISED CONTROLLED TRIAL
Projects.Description: SHOCK IS A COMMON CAUSE OF DEATH IN ICU. NEARLY ALL PATIENTS WITH SHOCK NEED MEDICATIONS TO SUPPORT THEIR BLOOD PRESSURE (BP). CURRENT PRACTICE OF STANDARD BP TARGET IS A ONE-SIZE-FITS-ALL APPROACH. TARGETING PATIENTS' USUAL PRE-ILLNESS BP IN ICU HAS NOT BEEN TESTED IN AN RCT. THEREFORE, WE AIM TO INVESTIGATE WHETHER BP TARGETS THAT APPROXIMATE PATIENTS' OWN PRE-ILLNESS BP READINGS CAN POTENTIALLY IMPROVE THE RATES OF DEATH AND MAJOR ADVERSE KIDNEY EVENTS AT DAY 14 AMONG ICU PATIENTS WITH SHOCK.

AN AWARD-WINNING INTERACTIVE TIME MACHINE APP COMPLETES THE PICTURE LITERALLY BY SHOWING HOW THOSE CHOICES AFFECT APPEARANCE. HEALTHLAB WILL TRAVEL TO LOCATIONS AROUND DARWIN AND NORTHEAST ARNHEM LAND, GIVING LOCALS THE OPPORTUNITY TO TALK TO A RANGE OF SCIENTISTS AND HEALTH PROFESSIONALS ABOUT THE SCIENCE BEHIND THE INNER WORKINGS OF THE HUMAN BODY, THE TECHNOLOGY BEHIND THE EQUIPMENT WE USE, AND EXCITING FUTURE CAREERS IN SCIENCE.

Projects.Description: THIS ADVOCACY AND AWARENESS INITIATIVE CONNECTS INDIGENOUS-OWNED COMMUNITY ORGANISATIONS IMPACTED BY GHOST NETS AND MARINE DEBRIS ACROSS THE GULF OF CARPENTARIA AND THE TORRES STRAIT WITH LEADING PRIVATE COMPANIES, EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS AND PROFESSIONALS WORKING WITHIN THE DESIGN, ARCHITECTURE, FASHION AND SCIENCE SECTORS. MELBOURNE DESIGN WEEK 2023 WILL SEE A DELEGATION OF INDIGENOUS TRADITIONAL OWNERS, SENIOR ARTISTS AND RANGERS TRAVELLING TO MELBOURNE TO SHARE THEIR CULTURAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL KNOWLEDGE OF THE PROBLEM, AS LEADERS AND CUSTODIANS OF THE LANDS AND SEA. REPRESENTATIVES FROM CREATIVE BUSINESSES WILL THEN VISIT A SOURCE COMMUNITY FOR A THINK TANK ON COUNTRY. THE PROJECT WILL END WITH A PUBLISHED REPORT THAT SUMMARISES THE RESULTS OF THIS CROSS-CULTURAL ENCOUNTER, PROPOSING AVENUES FOR INTERDISCIPLINARY COLLABORATION AND SOLUTIONS AROUND THE USE OF GHOST NETS AND MARINE DEBRIS IN THE DESIGN INDUSTRIES

Projects.Title: CAN ANIMAL DISPERSAL INFORM FIRE MANAGEMENT FOR SPECIES CONSERVATION?
Projects.Description: THIS PROJECT AIMS TO IMPROVE FIRE MANAGEMENT FOR ENVIRONMENTAL OUTCOMES IN NORTHERN AUSTRALIA. IT WILL ADDRESS A KEY KNOWLEDGE GAP IN OUR UNDERSTANDING OF THE EFFECTS OF FIRE ON BIODIVERSITY, RELATING TO THE SPATIAL PATTERN OF FIRE IN THE LANDSCAPE. THIS IS IMPORTANT BECAUSE CHANGING PATTERNS OF FIRE ARE NOT ONLY A RISK TO HUMANS BUT HAVE MAJOR EFFECTS ON OUR ENVIRONMENT. THIS PROJECT WILL INVOLVE RESEARCHERS, ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGERS AND INDIGENOUS LAND OWNERS TO DESIGN BETTER FIRE MANAGEMENT STRATEGIES FOR BIODIVERSITY. THE KEY BENEFITS INCLUDE NEW KNOWLEDGE AND TOOLS TO BETTER MANAGE FIRE AND ADDRESS ONE OF OUR MAJOR ENVIRONMENTAL CHALLENGES, THE DECLINE OF NATIVE WILDLIFE IN NORTHERN AUSTRALIA.

Projects.Title: UNPACKING THE POLICY PROCESS: ALCOHOL POLICY IN COMPLEX SOCIAL ENVIRONMENTS
Projects.Description: IN PURSUIT OF EFFECTIVE ALCOHOL POLICIES, EXPERTS HAVE FOCUSED ON PROMOTING EVIDENCE-BASED SOLUTIONS, ASSUMING THAT POLICYMAKERS WILL SELECT POLICIES ON THE BASIS OF RESEARCH EVIDENCE. HOWEVER, THIS LINEAR MODEL OF EVIDENCE-BASED POLICY RARELY PLAYS OUT WHEN RELATED TO HIGHLY CONTESTED SOCIAL ISSUES SUCH AS ALCOHOL USE. WE NEED NEW WAYS OF THINKING ABOUT INFLUENCING ALCOHOL POLICY THAT ACCOUNT FOR AND ENGAGE WITH THE REALITIES OF POLICYMAKING IN SOCIALLY COMPLEX REGIONS, PARTICULARLY POLICY RELATING TO ABORIGINAL AND TORRES STRAIT ISLANDER PEOPLES. THIS DECRA WILL ADDRESS THIS CRITICAL GAP IN KNOWLEDGE BY GENERATING KNOWLEDGE ON ALCOHOL POLICY PROCESSES, WITH A VIEW TO INFORMING MORE EFFECTIVE ENGAGEMENT IN THE ALCOHOL POLICYMAKING PROCESS.

PACIFICAUS SPORTS DOES THIS BY FOSTERING ELITE SPORT PATHWAYS AND LINKAGES THAT FACILITATE REGULAR COMPETITION AND ENGAGEMENT BETWEEN AUSTRALIA AND PACIFIC TEAMS, ATHLETES AND OTHER SPORT STAKEHOLDERS. THE OBJECTIVES OF PACIFICAUS SPORTS PARTNERSHIP GRANTS ARE: (1) DEVELOPING PATHWAYS FOR PACIFIC TEAMS AND ATHLETES TO PLAY IN HIGH LEVEL AUSTRALIAN SPORTS COMPETITIONS: (2) SUPPORTING AUSTRALIAN SPORTS CODES TO INCREASE THEIR PRESENCE AND PARTICIPATION IN THE PACIFIC; AND (3) DEVELOPING PATHWAYS FOR EMERGING ATHLETES FROM THE REGION TO BENEFIT FROM HIGH PERFORMANCE COACHING, TRAINING, AND COMPETITION. THIS GRANT WILL ENABLE NETBALL AUSTRALIA TO CONTRIBUTE TO THESE OBJECTIVES USING NETBALL THROUGH ACTIVITIES INCLUDING SUPPORT FOR PACIFIC TEAMS AND PLAYERS TO COMPETE AND TRAIN IN AUSTRALIA, SUPPORT FOR AUSTRALIAN NETBALL CLUBS TO ENGAGE WITH THE PACIFIC, AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF HIGH PERFORMANCE WORKSHOPS AND COACHING DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS.

Projects.Title: RANGINGUR: A YOLNGU DIGITAL ART OF RENEWAL
Projects.Description: THE YOLNGU WORD RANGINGUR MEANS COMING FROM THE BEACH. THIS COLLABORATION WITH YOLNGU RESEARCHERS SEEKS TO ENRICH AUSTRALIA'S UNDERSTANDING OF THE BEACH AS A CRITICAL ZONE OF INDIGENOUS HISTORY, IDENTITY, AND ENVIRONMENTAL KNOWLEDGE. CONCERNED THAT THEY FACE A DEVASTATING TIPPING POINT, PARTICIPANTS SEEK TO USE CO-CREATIVE METHODS TO DOCUMENT ENDANGERED SONGS, STORIES, AND BEACH ENVIRONMENTS. NEW KNOWLEDGE WILL BE PRODUCED ABOUT INDIGENOUS OBSERVATIONS OF - AND RESPONSES TO - ENVIRONMENTAL THREAT. OUTPUTS WILL INCLUDE A WEBSITE CO-DESIGNED BY RITUAL AND DIGITAL EXPERTS. MULTIPLE GENERATIONS OF YOLNGU FAMILIES, AND THE WIDER AUSTRALIAN COMMUNITY, WILL BENEFIT AS THIS PROJECT MODELS NEW OF WAYS OF CARING FOR COASTAL FUTURES.

Projects.Description: ACUTE LOWER RESPIRATORY INFECTIONS (ALRI) ARE A LEADING CAUSE OF HOSPITALISATION IN INDIGENOUS CHILDREN OF AUSTRALIA AND NEW ZEALAND. OUR INTERNATIONAL, MULTI-CENTRE, RANDOMISED CONTROLLED TRIAL WILL DETERMINE WHETHER WEEKLY AZITHROMYCIN FOR 12-MONTHS, REDUCES ALRI-HOSPITALISATIONS AND FUTURE BRONCHIECTASIS AMONG INDIGENOUS CHILDREN. WE WILL ALSO DETERMINE THE IMPACT OF AZITHROMYCIN ON ALRI RATES, SAFETY, ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE, IMPACT ON THE UPPER AIRWAY BACTERIA, AND COST-EFFECTIVENESS.

Projects.Title: NEW PASSIVE IMMUNISATION, NIRSEVIMAB, TO PREVENT SEVERE RESPIRATORY INFECTIONS AMONG FIRST NATIONS CHILDREN IN THE NORTHERN TERRITORY: A PRAGMATIC RANDOMISED CONTROLLED TRIAL
Projects.Description: RESPIRATORY SYNCYTIAL VIRUS (RSV) IS A LEADING CAUSE OF SEVERE RESPIRATORY INFECTIONS IN CHILDREN. Projects.Title: HOW SAFE ARE ISLAND HAVENS FOR BIODIVERSITY?
Projects.Description: THIS PROJECT WILL BE A PARTNERSHIP BETWEEN SCIENTISTS AND FIRST NATIONS RANGERS TO ASSESS THE EFFECTIVENESS OF AUSTRALIAN ISLANDS AS BIODIVERSITY HAVENS. THROUGH COMPREHENSIVE SURVEYS AND HISTORICAL DATA FROM THE VAST ISLAND ESTATE IN NORTHERN AUSTRALIA, THE PROJECT WILL QUANTIFY CHANGES IN BIODIVERSITY AND THREATS IN RELATION TO BIOGEOGRAPHY, CLIMATE RISK AND MANAGEMENT. A KEY OUTCOME WILL BE A CLASSIFICATION OF ISLANDS BASED ON CONSERVATION OPPORTUNITY AND RISK IN THE CONTEXT OF CULTURAL AND MANAGEMENT CONSIDERATIONS. OUTCOMES INCLUDE INCREASED CONSERVATION EFFECTIVENESS, STRENGTHENED COLLABORATIONS AND TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES FOR INDIGENOUS COMMUNITIES, CONTRIBUTING TO THE PRESERVATION OF AUSTRALIA'S BIODIVERSITY.

Projects.Title: CLAY ON COUNTRY Â€ CERAMICS FROM THE CENTRAL DESERT
Projects.Description: CLAY ON COUNTRY IS A CELEBRATION OF CLAY, COMMUNITY, CULTURE AND CREATIVITY, DEVELOPED TO COINCIDE WITH THE 16TH AUSTRALIAN CERAMICS TRIENNALE HELD IN MPARNWE (ALICE SPRINGS). SHOWCASING THE ENTHUSIASM FOR CERAMIC PRACTICE IN THE CENTRAL DESERT REGION THE EXHIBITION IS A DIVERSE AND ECLECTIC SURVEY, THE FIRST OF ITS KIND, INCLUDING 35 ARTISTS AND COLLECTIVES. SOME ARE ESTABLISHED CERAMIC ARTISTS, SOME ARE RECONNECTING WITH THE MEDIUM, OTHERS ARE INCORPORATING CLAY INTO THEIR PRACTICE FOR THE FIRST TIME. ALL HAVE PRODUCED ACCOMPLISHED, INSIGHTFUL AND CONTEMPORARY WORKS THAT REFLECT THE CULTURALLY AND HISTORICALLY RICH AND COMPLEX REGION WHERE THEY LIVE AND WORK.

Projects.Title: PASAR MALAM / NIGHT MARKET; CONTEMPORARY PRINTMAKING FROM INDONESIA AND AUSTRALIA
Projects.Description:
PASAR MALAM / NIGHT MARKET IS AN EXHIBITION OF LARGE FORMAT SCREENPRINTS BY 15 LEADING ARTISTS FROM AUSTRALIA, INDONESIA AND THEIR DIASPORAS. THE ENIGMATIC REALM OF THE INDONESIAN NIGHT MARKET SERVES AS THE CENTRAL MOTIF TO DELVE INTO THE VIBRANT WORLD OF CARNIVALS, CROSS-CULTURAL EXPERIENCES, GENDER ISSUES, AND POLITICAL HISTORIES. THIS EXHIBITION PROMISES AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE THAT INCLUDES PRINT WORKSHOPS, PUBLIC ART, COLLABORATIONS WITH LOCAL COMMUNITIES AND KARAOKE.

TOURING TO 6 VENUES IN NEW SOUTH WALES, NORTHERN TERRITORY, WESTERN AUSTRALIA AND QUEENSLAND.

Projects.Title: ATYPICAL BACTERIA IN CHRONIC SUPPURATIVE OTITIS MEDIA
Projects.Description: CHRONIC SUPPURATIVE OTITIS MEDIA (CSOM) IS A SERIOUS MIDDLE EAR INFECTION, WHICH CAN CAUSE HEARING LOSS, AND LONG-TERM IMPACTS ON SPEECH AND LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT. GENOMIC ANALYSIS OF CSOM EAR DISCHARGE HAS REVEALED A BACTERIAL GENUS NOT USUALLY ASSOCIATED WITH MIDDLE EAR INFECTIONS, CALLED OLIGELLA. WE AIM TO DETERMINE IF OLIGELLA CAN OR CAUSE CONTRIBUTE TO INFECTION, DEVELOP NEW WAYS TO TEST FOR OLIGELLA, AND DETERMINE ITS PREVALENCE IN CSOM IN THE NORTHERN TERRITORY, NSW AND PAPUA NEW GUINEA.

Projects.Title: A GENE DRIVE TO CONTROL MALARIA
Projects.Description: MALARIA IS A MAJOR GLOBAL KILLER, AND DEATHS ARE INCREASING. GENE DRIVES ARE POWERFUL GENETIC TOOLS TO ERADICATE PATHOGENS. WE BUILT A GENE DRIVE TO ELIMINATE MALARIA. Projects.Title: AN ULTRA-SHORT COURSE OF PRIMAQUINE FOR THE RADICAL CURE OF VIVAX MALARIA
Projects.Description: CURRENT TREATMENT REGIMENS TO PREVENT RELAPSING MALARIA ARE TOO LONG. A SHORTER HIGHER DOSE TREATMENT COULD IMPROVE TREATMENT OUTCOMES BUT THIS NEEDS TO BE BALANCED AGAINST INCREASED RISK OF SIDE EFFECTS. RECENT DATA FROM A TRIAL IN CHILDREN IN PNG SUGGESTS A SHORTENED TREATMENT OF 3 DAYS IS SAFE AND EFFECTIVE. OUR MULTICENTRE TRIAL WILL ASSESS THE SAFETY AND EFFICACY OF AN ULTRA-SHORT PRIMAQUINE COURSE. THIS TRIAL IS EXPECTED TO DIRECTLY INFLUENCE GLOBAL TREATMENT POLICIES.

Projects.Title: TACKLING ANTIMICROBIAL RESISTANCE IN REMOTE AUSTRALIA (TARRA)
Projects.Description: INAPPROPRIATE ANTIBIOTIC USE IS COMMON IN RURAL AND REMOTE AUSTRALIA, CONTRIBUTING TO HIGH RATES OF ANTIMICROBIAL RESISTANCE (AMR) THAT DISPROPORTIONATELY IMPACT LOCAL COMMUNITIES. THIS PROJECT WILL IMPLEMENT A COMPREHENSIVE ANTIMICROBIAL STEWARDSHIP (AMS) PROGRAM IN REMOTE NT PRIMARY HEALTHCARE CLINICS, ADAPTED FROM AN ESTABLISHED HOSPITAL-BASED MODEL. THE PROGRAM WILL USE MULTI-MODAL STRATEGIES, INCLUDING ANTIMICROBIAL USAGE SURVEILLANCE, VIRTUAL CLINICAL SUPPORT, AND TARGETED EDUCATION AND HEALTH PROMOTION FOR HEALTH PROVIDERS AND COMMUNITIES. THESE ACTIVITIES WILL IMPROVE PRESCRIBING PRACTICES, STRENGTHEN HOSPITALPRIMARY CARE PARTNERSHIPS, AND BUILD CAPACITY TO CURB AMR AND IMPROVE HEALTH OUTCOMES IN REMOTE COMMUNITIES.

HistoryDescription:
The central business area of the city derives its name from the harbour which was named by Wickham and Stokes in 1839 after their former shipmate, Charles Darwin, who had been with them on a previous voyage in the "HMS Beagle".  

Surveyor-General Goyder when he established the settlement in 1869 named the town - Palmerston - but by 1900 this had reverted to Port Darwin and later to simply Darwin - since all communications were by sea, goods and passengers continued to be consigned to PORT DARWIN.   

In 1911, when the Commonwealth relieved the State of South Australia of the economic burden the Territory had become, DARWIN was adopted as the official name of the capital.

Demographics.Comments: Estimates of the total population resident at the community on Census nights (August) in 2011, 2016 and 2021. Estimates are not a definitive population number and, for a range of reasons, should be considered as a guide to resident numbers.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Median age of persons
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Median age (in years) of the population at the time of the Census (excludes overseas visitors).

PopulationIndicators.Label: Median total personal income ($/weekly)
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Median total personal income ($/ weekly) at the time of the Census. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and over.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Median total family income ($/weekly)
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Median total family income ($/ weekly) at the time of the Census.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Median total household income ($/weekly)
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Median total household income ($/weekly) at the time of the Census. It excludes 'Visitors only' and 'Other non-classifiable' households.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Average number of persons per bedroom
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Average number of persons per bedroom at the time of the Census. It excludes 'Visitors only' and 'Other non-classifiable' households.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Average household size
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Average number of persons per household at the time of the Census. It excludes 'Visitors only' and 'Other non-classifiable' households.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Percent households where rent payments are more than 30% of household (RAID) income
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Proportion of households for whom rent payments were more than 30% of household income at the time of the Census.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Unemployment
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Unemployment rate (%) at the time of the Census. This is the number of unemployed persons expressed as a percentage of the total labour force. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Labour force participation
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Labour force participation rate (%) at the time of the Census. This is the number of unemployed persons expressed as a percentage of the total labour force. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Employment to population
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Employment to population rate (%) at the time of the Census. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of core activity need for assistance
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Number of people with a profound or severe core activity limitation. People with a profound or severe core activity limitation are those needing assistance in their day to day lives.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of long-term health conditions (per 1,000)
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Rates of long-term health conditions (per 1, 000 population). This measures the number of people who reported that they have been told by a doctor or nurse that they have any of these long-term health conditions.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of caring (unpaid) for a person with a disability, health condition, or due to old age
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Rates of unpaid caring provided to a person with a disability, health condition, or due to old age (%).

AliasNameDescription: The community Elliott is not known to have any other aliases.
HistoryDescription: A military staging camp was established by Reginalid Douglas Elliott in 1940 in this area.  It became known as "Elliott", so the name is perpetuated by naming the population centre  "Elliott".

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Engawala is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply.
Engawala has a limited groundwater source with adequate quality water, which is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and monitored monthly for microbes.
Engawala has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Eastern Arrente, Alyawarr
Barkly Regional Council
Barkly
Engawala is a Community Living Area on the Alkwert Aboriginal Land Trust (previously the Alcoota Pastoral Property). Alcoota fossil site is just south of the community.

Demographics.Comments: Estimates of the total population resident at the community on Census nights (August) in 2011, 2016 and 2021. Estimates are not a definitive population number and, for a range of reasons, should be considered as a guide to resident numbers.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Median age of persons
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Median age (in years) of the population at the time of the Census (excludes overseas visitors).

PopulationIndicators.Label: Median total personal income ($/weekly)
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Median total personal income ($/ weekly) at the time of the Census. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and over.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Median total family income ($/weekly)
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Median total family income ($/ weekly) at the time of the Census.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Median total household income ($/weekly)
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Median total household income ($/weekly) at the time of the Census. It excludes 'Visitors only' and 'Other non-classifiable' households.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Average number of persons per bedroom
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Average number of persons per bedroom at the time of the Census. It excludes 'Visitors only' and 'Other non-classifiable' households.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Average household size
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Average number of persons per household at the time of the Census. It excludes 'Visitors only' and 'Other non-classifiable' households.

PopulationIndicators.Label: Percent households where rent payments are more than 30% of household (RAID) income
PopulationIndicators.Comments: Proportion of households for whom rent payments were more than 30% of household income at the time of the Census.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Unemployment
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Unemployment rate (%) at the time of the Census. This is the number of unemployed persons expressed as a percentage of the total labour force. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Labour force participation
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Labour force participation rate (%) at the time of the Census. This is the number of unemployed persons expressed as a percentage of the total labour force. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

LabourForceIndicators.Label: % Employment to population
LabourForceIndicators.Comments: Employment to population rate (%) at the time of the Census. Applicable to persons aged 15 years and older.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of core activity need for assistance
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Number of people with a profound or severe core activity limitation. People with a profound or severe core activity limitation are those needing assistance in their day to day lives.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of long-term health conditions (per 1,000)
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Rates of long-term health conditions (per 1, 000 population). This measures the number of people who reported that they have been told by a doctor or nurse that they have any of these long-term health conditions.

HealthCareIndicators.Label: Rates of caring (unpaid) for a person with a disability, health condition, or due to old age
HealthCareIndicators.Comments: Rates of unpaid caring provided to a person with a disability, health condition, or due to old age (%).

Name: FINKE
Description: The community is located 434 km south east of Alice Springs via Erldunda (bitumen) and Kulgera (dirt) or travel 235 km SE of Alice Springs - via Titjikala (Old South Road -4WD track). It takes 4.5 hours to drive there. When flying, it takes 3 minutes to drive to the closest airstrip in to the community then 45 minutes to fly to Alice Springs. The road from Alice Springs to the community is a combination of sealed and unsealed sections.

Services.Comments: Travel from Alice Springs via the Stuart Highway to Kulgera Roadhouse, (270 km), turn left via the Finke Road to Finke (147 km, all dirt road. Always check road conditions prior to travel. Erldunda Roadhouse, (200 km from Alice) and Kulgera Roadhouse are available for fuel and food.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Finke is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply.
Finke has a plentiful groundwater source with good quality water, which is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and monitored monthly for microbes.
Finke has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Pitjantjatjara, Yankunytjatjara, Southern Luritja
MacDonnell Regional Council
Namatjira
Finke is located near the South Australian border on and surrounded by the pastoral properties of Lilla Creek, Umbeara and New Crown with the Simpson Desert just west of the community.

Name: GALIWINKU
Description:
The community is located on the southern end of Elcho Island in North East Arnhem land.  Elcho Island is at the southern end of the Wessell Island group, and is bounded on the western side by the Arafura Sea and on the east by Cadell Strait.  Elcho Island is 550 km east of Darwin and 150 km north west of Nhulunbuy.

Apart from the weekly freight barge service, Galiwinku is accessed primarily by air.  There is an all weather, bitumised air strip located at the community.  Travel time to Nhulunbuy: 30-45 minutes, to Darwin: 1.5 hours.

Projects.Title: SHEPHERDSON COLLEGE STUDENTS TO SANTOS SCIENCE EXPERIENCE
Projects.Description: MIDDLE YEARS STUDENTS FROM SHEPHERDSON COLLEGE WILL PARTICIPATE IN A 4 DAY HANDS-ON AND ENGAGING SERIES OF WORKSHOPS AND PRACTICAL STEM EXPERIENCES AT CHARLES DARWIN UNIVERSITY AS PART OF THE SANTOS SCIENCE EXPERIENCE. DUE TO THE VERY REMOTE CONTEXT OF THE SCHOOL, SITUATED ON ELCHO ISLAND, NORTH EAST ARNHEM LAND, STUDENTS HAVE LIMITED OPPORTUNITY TO EXPERIENCE EVENTS SUCH AS THIS. THIS PROJECT PRESENTS A SIGNIFICANT OPPORTUNITY IN THE LIVES OF THESE STUDENTS TO DEEPEN THEIR UNDERSTANDING OF STEM AND THE OPPORTUNITIES THAT EXIST FOR TERTIARY EDUCATION AND CAREERS IN THE FIELD. THIS HELPS TO EXPAND ON WHAT STUDENTS ENVISAGE FOR THEIR FUTURE, BROADENING THEIR HORIZONS AS THEY LEARN TO WALK IN TWO WORLDS: YOLNGU AND BALANDA.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Galiwinku is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply.
Galiwinku has good quality water with an adequate groundwater supply.
Galiwinku has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Yolngu Matha (Djambarrpuyngu, Gupapuyngu, Djinang)
Galpu
East Arnhem Regional Council
Nhulunbuy

Galiwinku is located on the southern end of Elcho Island in North East Arnhem land west of Nhulunbuy.  Elcho Island is at the southern end of the Wessell Island group, and is bounded on the western side by the Arafura Sea and on the east by Cadell Strait.

Name: GAPUWIYAK
Description:
The commuity is situated adjacent to Lake Evella and the upper reaches of the Buckinham River in North East Arnhem Land.  Gapuwiyak is approximately 60km south east of Elcho Island, 40km inland from Arnhem Bay, and about 22okm west south west of Nhulunbuy.

The community is accessible by road or air.  Road access, 4wd only, is via a turn-off from the Central Arnhem road about 200km from Nhulunbuy.  Travel time from Nhulunbuy is approximately 2.5 hours depending on road/weather conditions.  There is a sealed airstriip in the community.  Travel time to Nhulunbuy is 30-35 mins.  A weekly freight barge service from Darwin lands goods at a landing 23km from Gapuwiyak.

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Gapuwiyak is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply.
Gapuwiyak has a limited groundwater source with very good quality water, which is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and monitored weekly for microbes.
Gapuwiyak has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Yolngu Matha (Djambarrpuyngu)
East Arnhem Regional Council
Arnhem
Gapuwiyak is located adjacent to Lake Evella and the upper reaches of the Buckinham River in North East Arnhem Land and is part of the Arnhem Land Aboriginal Land Trust.

Name: GUNBALANYA
Description: The community is located in Arnhem Land approximately 330km east of Darwin and 60km NNE of Jabiru. The community is situated near the East Alligator River on A small ridge between coastal black soil plain, marshes and the Arnhem Land Escarpment.
HistoryDesc:
Gunbalunya is a mostly Aboriginal community, east of Jabiru in western Arnhem Land and 320km east of Darwin.

Originally established by Paddy Cahill as his homestead in 1906 when he took up a Pastoral Lease in the area and established a diary herd there.   Cahill named his property Oenpelli, an anglisised pronounciation of the name Un-balange.

In 1916 Gilruth's administration acquired Cahill herd and employed his as manager. In October 1925 the Church Mission Society took up a 2000 sq km lease in the area and managed the community until the 1970s when the Gunbalanya Council Inc.  was registered and took over management of the community following the Government's policy of self-determination.

The Kunbarllanjnja Community Government Council was established in 1995.

In 2001, following a request from the Council the name Oenpelli was changed to Gunbalanya, a name the council considered easier to pronounce than the more traditional Kunbarllanjnja.

Services.Comments: Red Dust

ProfileSections.Content: Electricity at Gunbalanya is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply.
Gunbalanya has good quality water, however the groundwater source is limited and community demand is continuously monitored to ensure that adequate supply can be maintained.
Gunbalanya has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Kunwinjku
West Arnhem Regional Council
Arafura

Gunbalanya is located east of Darwin within Arnhem Land near the East Alligator River on a small ridge between coastal black soil plain, marshes and the Arnhem Land Escarpment. Gunbalanya is part of the Arnhem Land Aboriginal Trust.
